description: This file defines the WorkExperience class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically as a display field for work experience data within reports. It extends a listable display field class and provides methods to specify the associated DTO class, entity alias, and relevant fields.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: Represents a display field for work experience data in reports, providing configuration for associated DTO, entity alias, and relevant fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) related to work experience.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the alias for the work experience entity used in queries or report generation.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Specifies which database fields are relevant for this display field, in this case, the employee number.
